descriptions.mistakesLimit: Number of mistake allowed in game
descriptions.showFeedbackOnMistake: Show feedback when mistake is made
descriptions.highlightCells: Highlight cells with different background colors
descriptions.allowAnyNote: Allow filling all the notes in cell
descriptions.fillOnCellClick: Lock number and fill on Cell tap
descriptions.soundsEnabled: Enable or disable all game sounds
descriptions.remindToTakeHint: Show reminders to use hints when stuck

snackbar.soundsOn: sounds have been enabled. now try pressing any cell in puzzle and you will hear the tunes
snackbar.soundsOff: no more sounds in game. wish you a nice meditative session
snackbar.allowAnyNoteOn:
in Preview do below
pick an empty cell and try to fill 1-9 as notes, notice now you can fill all the notes
snackbar.allowAnyNoteOff:
in Preview do below
in 1st try to fill all the notes. notice only 1, 4, 8 can be filled
snackbar.fillNoteShortClickOn:
now notes will be filled without turning on Pencil. just press the number.
long press the number to fill cell with it's soluton
snackbar.fillNoteShortClickOff: now you have to turn on Pencil to fill notes in cell
snackbar.fillOnCellClickOn:
now numbers & Notes will be filled faster.In Preview do below
a. long press any number to lock it
b. tap on an empty cell and number will be filled
snackbar.fillOnCellClickOff: now you have to first select a cell and then press on number to fill
snackbar.highlightCellsOn: now cells will have colorful backgrounds
snackbar.highlightCellsOff: all the cells will have same background like solving Sudoku on paper
snackbar.highlightNotesOn:
now notes will be highlighted in puzzle.
in Preview do below
  a. click Fast Pencil
  b. select a filled cell
notice notes have been highlighted
snackbar.highlightNotesOff:
in Preview do below
  a. click Fast Pencil
  b. select a filled cell
notice all the notes have same color
snackbar.remindHintOn: we will remind you to use hint at a regular interval when no progress is made in puzzle
snackbar.remindHintOff: you are the champ. no more reminders to take hint
snackbar.gameOverMistakesOn: game will be over once your mistakes count is {{MISTAKES_LIMIT}}. WATCH OUT!
snackbar.gameOverMistakesOff: game won't be over on making mistakes. BE FEARLESS!
snackbar.showFeedbackOn:
in Preview do below
 a. fill 1 in first cell
it's a mistake and see mistakes count has gone up
snackbar.showFeedbackOff:
in Preview do below
 a. fill 1 in first cell
it's a mistake and see you can't notice it in preview
snackbar.fillNotesWithoutPencilOn: in Preview now you will see 2 input panels, one for notes and one for main numbers
snackbar.fillNotesWithoutPencilOff: now you have to tap on Pencil first before filling Notes

gameSettings.tooltip: change settings and click here to see how the Game Experience changes
